value.description: The controlled value of the editable.

default-value.description:
The initial value of the editable when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the editable.

placeholder.description: The placeholder text for the editable.

edit.description: Whether the editable is in edit mode.

default-edit.description: Whether the editable is in edit mode by default.

activation-mode.description:
The activation mode for the preview element.

- "focus" - Enter edit mode when the preview is focused
- "dblclick" - Enter edit mode when the preview is double-clicked
- "click" - Enter edit mode when the preview is clicked
- "none" - Edit can be triggered programmatically only

submit-mode.description:
The action that triggers submit in the edit mode:

- "enter" - Trigger submit when the enter key is pressed
- "blur" - Trigger submit when the editable is blurred
- "none" - No action will trigger submit. You need to use the submit button
- "both" - Pressing `Enter` and blurring the input will trigger submit

select-on-focus.description: Whether to select the text in the input when it is focused.

auto-resize.description: Whether the editable should auto-resize to fit the content.

max-length.description: The maximum number of characters allowed in the editable

invalid.description: Whether the input's value is invalid.

name.description: The name attribute of the editable component. Used for form submission.

form.description: The associate form of the underlying input.

as-child.description: Apply the props to the first child element instead of this element.

debug.description: Log state transitions, events and prop changes to the console. Applies to descendants too.

editchange.description: Fired when the edit mode changes.

valuerevert.description: Fired when the value is reverted.

valuecommit.description: Fired when the value is committed.

pointerdownoutside.description: Fired when the pointer is pressed down outside the component

focusoutside.description: Fired when the focus is moved outside the component

interactoutside.description: Fired when an interaction happens outside the component

finalFocusEl.description: The element to receive focus when the editable is closed.

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the editable. Useful for composition.

ready.description: Resolves once the element's machine has started, so `api`, state and parts are in place.

api.description: The Zag API of the component. `undefined` until it connects.
